Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Scope of Work & Standards. (a) Site Survey of Equipment. The prospective bidder to carry out site survey of equipment to be repaired before submission of their bid, check the equipment, its defect and the work required to be ca rried out as part of contract for repair of the equipment. A certificate to this effect that site survey of equip ment has been carried out is to be obtained from buyer, duly signed by buyer’s representative and submit ted along with the bid. Non-submission of the site survey certificate duly signed by buyer’s representative would result in disqualification of tech bid without giving any justification from buyer. (b) All spares, components, consumables, labour, testing of equipment to be catered and brought by th e service provider for repair of equipment. The complete work including installation, testing and commissi oning of the equipment to be carried out by the seller. On completion of repair task, service provider to ca rry out testing of equipment in present of buyer representative. (c) The repair is to be carried out strictly as per the scope of work of this bid. 2. Warranty & Quality Assurance. (a) Warranty Period. A minimum of 6 to 12 months warranty must be provided for the repair of equi pment. (b) Pre-delivery Inspection. Buyer reserves the right to reject defective or damaged parts with all re placement and transport costs borne by the vendor. 3. Documents. (a) Bidder should be uploaded all the documents asked in this bid. (b) No document to be uploaded multiple times. Any document found to be uploaded with bid more tha n once would not be considered for evaluation and would be marked as rejected. 4. Logistics & Turnaround Time.

(a) Turnaround Time (TAT). The repair/overhaul services must be completed and delivered within 5 days. (b) Collection & Delivery. The vendor is responsible for repair of equipment at buyer premises, as the unit is located at remote area in Arunachal Pradesh. 5. Local Office & Address. The seller/Bidders must have functional service centre located in district o f Dhemaji and near to buyer location in case of carry-in-warranty. A documentary evidence to be submitte d to this office against having local service centre. This is mandatory requirements and non forwarding of the same would render the bid liable for rejection. 6. Payment. 100% payment against the contract will be made only after successful completion of work as per scope of work, their installation and testin g by seller at buyer’s place and after successful inspection by buyer’s represent ative and furnishing of work completion certificate. Work completion certificate to be obtained by service provider from the user section/inspection authority. . 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
